description: Header file defining the interface for the WLAN Station/Client hardware abstraction layer (HAL) in the prplMesh project. It declares the 'sta_wlan_hal' class with enums, methods, and a factory function.

classes.name: sta_wlan_hal
classes.description: Abstract class representing the WLAN Station/Client hardware abstraction layer, providing methods for connection management, scanning, and configuration.

methods.name: ~sta_wlan_hal
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the sta_wlan_hal class.

methods.name: start_wps_pbc
methods.description: Initiates WPS push-button configuration.

methods.name: initiate_scan
methods.description: Starts a scan for available networks.

methods.name: scan_bss
methods.description: Triggers a scan for a specific BSS (Basic Service Set) on a given channel and frequency type.

methods.name: get_scan_results
methods.description: Retrieves scan results for a specified SSID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified Wi-Fi network with given credentials and parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: roam
methods.description: Performs roaming to a specified BSSID and channel.

methods.name: get_4addr_mode
methods.description: Checks if 4-address mode is enabled.

methods.name: set_4addr_mode
methods.description: Enables or disables 4-address mode.

methods.name: set_3addr_mcast
methods.description: Enables or disables 3-address multicast mode.

methods.name: unassoc_rssi_measurement
methods.description: Performs an unassociated RSSI measurement for a given MAC address.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if the station is currently connected.

methods.name: get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the current Wi-Fi channel.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the WLAN interface.

methods.name: get_ssid
methods.description: Returns the SSID of the connected network.

methods.name: get_bssid
methods.description: Returns the BSSID of the connected network.

methods.name: clear_non_associated_devices
methods.description: Clears records of non-associated devices.

methods.name: update_mld_mode
methods.description: Updates the MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) mode.

methods.name: update_mld_unit
methods.description: Updates the MLD unit.

methods.name: get_wireless_backhaul_mac
methods.description: Returns the backhaul MAC address.

methods.name: enable_disable_ep
methods.description: Enables or disables endpoint functionality.
